summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on clarifying how the API endpoint `/api/campaigns/target/total-traffic` handles time parameters. Specifically, it addressed whether `iwh` (using inventory working hours) and `periods` (setting specific working hours) are mutually exclusive or if one takes priority.

Someone noted that while they were unsure of the exact logic, they believed an intersection calculation was used.
decisions: The API endpoint `/api/campaigns/target/total-traffic` uses both `iwh` and `periods` parameters for time definition.
